recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for this historical broken-link issue; future observation-focusCode maintenance belongs to the FHIR Extension Pack or to a new OO decision about the deprecated extension.
issue_request: FHIR-17795 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for FHIR-core Observation requesting that the Observation.focus comment link to focusCode use extension-observation-focuscode.html rather than the broken mixed-case extension-Observation-focusCode.html.
initial_application: Commit dfe20c1cb32be225c03639320b6c377955889f20 applied the request to source/observation/observation-spreadsheet.xml by changing the link to extension-observation-focuscode.html. That spreadsheet was later removed when Observation moved to the StructureDefinition XML source used by the current build.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini and source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml is the current authoritative source. Later history migrated the lower-case link into the StructureDefinition, canonicalized extension link markup, and then a later FHIR-43357 reconciliation removed the old focusCode guidance from the current Observation.focus comment. The observation-focusCode extension now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack and was deprecated/retired through FHIR-44333, while FHIR-44709 is related modeling context but not part of this link correction.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml has no focusCode markdown link in Observation.focus, and source searches found no mixed-case extension-Observation-focusCode.html or lower-case extension-observation-focuscode.html link under current source/observation. The only current core source hit is the canonical OID entry for http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/observation-focusCode.
